criteria.requirement: Implement tenacity.retry.retry_if_exception_group(predicate,*,mode="all") as retry_base. On a failed outcome traverse nested BaseExceptionGroup leaves iteratively in source order, apply all/any short-circuit logic; ordinary exceptions are a single leaf. Success returns False without invoking the predicate; missing outcome raises RuntimeError. Preserve leaf identity, original exception structure, predicate exceptions and composition with retry_all/retry_any. Validate callable/mode; integrate with actual Retrying without flattening or replacing delivered groups. This feature targets the pinned Python 3.12 environment.
